name: d4-cms-core
description: Admin shell every content module plugs into: password login with optional TOTP 2FA, a dashboard that renders panels from the generated admin-panels registry, a libSQL-backed data store (src/lib/cms/data-store.ts, Turso in production / a local SQLite file in dev), a markdown renderer, and an authenticated image upload endpoint that stores files in Vercel Blob (falling back to public/uploads in dev). Ships a built-in "Pages" editor for the site's own copy (home hero, services, about, contact, FAQ) and overrides the base template's src/lib/site-content.ts with a DB-backed getLiveContent() so those pages reflect owner edits without a rebuild.
clientFacingSummary: A private admin area where you sign in and edit your own site content, protected by a password and optional two-factor authentication.

env.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.description: Password for the /admin login. Set a strong unique value per site; flag it rotate-before-handoff.

env.name: TOTP_SECRET
env.description: Base32 TOTP secret enabling two-factor login. When unset, login is password-only and /admin/setup-2fa explains how to enable it.

env.name: TURSO_DATABASE_URL
env.description: libsql:// URL of this client's Turso database. When unset, the CMS falls back to a local SQLite file under data/cms.db (dev only — not for production).

env.name: TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Auth token for TURSO_DATABASE_URL. Required whenever TURSO_DATABASE_URL is set.

env.name: BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN
env.description: Vercel Blob store token for uploaded images and files. One of two ways to give this site permanent storage; the S3_* variables are the other, and work on any host. With neither set, uploads are refused in production rather than written to disk a redeploy would erase.

env.name: S3_BUCKET
env.description: Bucket for uploaded images and files on any S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, MinIO, AWS). Set alongside S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID and S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY as the vendor-neutral alternative to BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN.

env.name: S3_ENDPOINT
env.description: Endpoint for S3_BUCKET, e.g. https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. Defaults to AWS S3 for the given region when unset.

env.name: S3_REGION
env.description: Region for S3_BUCKET. Defaults to us-east-1; use "auto" for Cloudflare R2.

env.name: S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
env.description: Public base URL visitors read uploaded files back from, when it differs from the endpoint (a CDN, or a public bucket domain).

postAssemble.notes: Content modules (careers, insights, catalog, gallery) import from @/lib/cms/* and register panels into src/config/admin-panels.generated.tsx, which the builder rewrites. This module must be selected whenever any of those modules are selected. It also ships src/lib/site-content.ts, which overrides the base template's static accessor of the same path (module payloads copy after the base in registry order) with a DB-backed, editable version; base pages read their copy through getLiveContent(), so this override is what makes the built-in Pages editor take effect live.
